invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.20.0 preserves Parts 1–21, the standalone permission-aware shell, focused mobile-safe settings, platform-wide readable light/dark selected states, Kenya eTIMS, international e-invoicing, recurring billing, dunning, portal, payments, credits, retainers, company-bound financial relationships and SaMi AI, and adds Part 22 immutable audit integrity: append-only per-company audit sequencing, SHA-256 hash chaining, mutation rejection, database-trigger capture across Invoicing tables, redaction of secrets and large provider payloads, chain-integrity verification, canonical audit resource names, invoice-detail audit proof, and migration-safe frontend fallback before audit objects exist. The 2.20.0 migration has been validated on a disposable Neon branch together with 2.19.0, including trigger capture, append-only rejection and end-to-end chain verification.
